name: Majestic Tours
brand_truth: A Bahamian family company that has met guests at the airport and taken them across the water since 1959.

design.signature: Illustrated route chart from Nassau to Rose Island, Blue Lagoon, Exuma Cays, Harbour Island and the reefs; tap a destination to list Majestic's real trips there

current_site_findings: The footer still says 2012-2021, and the homepage shows no phone number or email.
Every tour page sends guests to info@majestictourbahamas.com, which is missing an 's': those emails probably never arrive.
Two pages list different hotel desks and different extensions.
37 excursions sit in one alphabetical list with no filters.
The 1959 founding and five industry awards are hidden on the About page.
pitch_line: You have been Nassau's tour company since 1959, but your site still says 2021 and your tour emails go to a misspelled address; this concept shows every trip on a chart and books it in one tap.
assumptions: Which hotel desks are current (two pages disagree)
Listed prices for Flying Cloud Evening Dinner and Exuma Day Trip are still current
Enquiries by email to transport@majesticholidays.com are accepted for tours
Tour category labels (Sea and islands, Sail and evening, etc.) are our grouping
notes: All photos hotlinked from majestictoursbahamas.com; many are 480px, so used in modest frames. Route chart is an illustration, not to scale. Tour rows link to the existing tour pages for details. No WhatsApp found; enquiry opens email. Scorecard: 1:4 2:4 3:4 4:5 5:4 6:4 7:5 8:4 9:4 10:4 11:4. Ask owner for logo files and high-res photography.
